description: Read-only Proxmox VE + Backup Server CLI: per-guest backup verdicts across every cluster, no write calls to Proxmox.

auth_env_var_specs.name: PROXMOX_API_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Proxmox VE API token as USER@REALM!TOKENID=SECRET (e.g. root@pam!cli=<uuid>); the CLI sends it as PVEAPIToken=...

env_var.name: PROXMOX_PBS_API_TOKEN
env_var.description: Proxmox Backup Server API token as USER@REALM!TOKENID:SECRET (colon before the secret); needed only for pbs-* commands and PBS columns

novel_features.name: Fleet backup posture
novel_features.description: One verdict per guest across every client cluster: covered by an enabled job, age of the newest real restore point, PBS verify state, last backup attempt.

novel_features.name: Coverage with reasons
novel_features.description: Every guest or disk that no enabled backup job includes, with the reason: no job, disabled job only, excluded, or disk excluded.

novel_features.name: Verify-failure spread
novel_features.description: Per PBS datastore and backup group: failed, never-verified and outdated snapshots, first failure, newest verified-good point, and namespaces no verify job reaches. Needs the PBS API.

novel_features.name: Failure triage
novel_features.description: Failed and silently incomplete backup, verify, GC, sync and prune tasks in a time window, one row per failed guest or datastore with the reason line.

novel_features.name: Fleet datastore runway
novel_features.description: PBS datastores ranked by days until full, plus every PVE backup storage by percent used (only PBS forecasts), with garbage-collection state and a GC-deadlock warning.

novel_features.name: Guest restore points
novel_features.description: Every restore point of one guest across its cluster's storages and PBS namespaces, with verify state, protection and encryption.

novel_features.name: RPO evidence
novel_features.description: Per guest over a past window: largest gap between restore points, scheduled runs with no restore point, and days with a verified-good point, rolled up per client.
